The '''Celestial School of Spaceflight Engineering''' was a learning center on [[Argus]]. It was closed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] circa [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]]. [[Maggis]] was a teacher there.
